snippet.title: Crime Simulator | Xbox Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Crime Simulator is coming to Xbox Series X|S on December 1st, 2025: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/crime-simulator/9P05MZMS92DQ – featuring single-player and online co-op for up to 4 players, Update 1.2 with a brand-new city map, fully drivable cars, as well as numerous gameplay improvements and expanded features.

👮Whether you are sneaking through fancy neighborhoods alone or working with your team, Crime Simulator lets players plan and carry out jobs across a big city with different areas, jobs, and targets. You can break into houses and steal valuables or take on dangerous missions for shady clients. Players can choose how to handle each heist, using sneaking, tools, or force, while improving their hideout, building their skills, and moving up from small-time criminal to mastermind.
